notes: Piece count matches the parts list exactly: 118 pieces, each type and colour as listed.

Pieces are numbered in booklet build order (steps 1-37). A 'rests_on' entry may name a later id when a piece is slid under an earlier one: base plates b11, b12 and b20 are added under blue plates b9/b10 and yellow plate b17.
The booklet does not give coordinates, so every rests_on list is an estimate from the isometric drawings. The face, ear and bow-tie pieces are the least certain.

Steps 21-28 (frame on the back of the canvas): the booklet drawing is ambiguous about how the bricks clutch the back. I recorded them as resting on the four 4x12 base plates, with the back pieces (b60-b70, b78-b81) resting on the base plates or on each other.

Step 26 stand: two white elbows (b76, b77) are joined by the red axle 2 notched (b73). Grey axles 11 (b71, b72) go in the other elbow ends. Hinge cylinders (b74, b75) sit on the axle ends and hinge onto the hinge plates (b68, b69). These are recorded as other_joins.
Step 37: the hinge top plate b118 clicks onto hinge base b107 and the black dome b117 sits on b118. b118 rests on nothing and is joined to b107 only through the hinge.
Steps 29 and 36 turn the model over, so the back-frame pieces are treated as built before the front face is finished.

The booklet lists the white 18646 and 18980 plates with different element numbers than the parts list. I followed the parts list: 18646 appears in steps 16 and 31, and 18980 in steps 33 (twice) and 35.
